trans.sense: pertaining to animals whose eggs hatch inside their body

examples.text: The anaconda is an ovoviviparous reptile.

glosses: Of or pertaining to such kind of animals such as some reptiles whose eggs hatch inside their body
categories: English entries with incorrect language header

examples.text: I have not had opportunities of examining any of the animals of this group preserved in spirits, but have found no difficulty in making out the fact of ovoviviparity by macerating the dried animal in cabinet specimens of the shells, when the oviduct in the females, in several species, was found to be filled with young animals with four- to six-whorled shells about one-eighth of an inch in length.

examples.text: […] the wide dispersal of certain household species, the development of ovoviviparity in several tropical forms and of myrmecophilous and sphegophilous habits in others […]

examples.text: The species with maternal care all fall in the monophyletic subgenus Gonioctena, but while ovoviviparity is also found in these species it also occurs in subgenera lacking maternal care.
